(1) PRELOAD: NEW tests/shaders/nord2_preload_uint.frag (texelFetch clamped by textureSize, uvec4 out) and nord2_frame_preload_uint.frag; tools/generate_preload.c/.sh emit n2_preload_uint_shader / n2_frame_preload_uint_shader (float preload bytes unchanged, verified). Bridge: preload_shader/frame_preload_shader/preload_format pick the uint program and the target's uint twin (n2r_rt_raw_twin, nord2_metal_render.h: same channel widths/bytes) as preload target AND binding format for every raw target at the frame-preload, LOAD-draw, batch frame-preload, batch LOAD and n2mb_clear sites -> bit copy, exact for integer, snorm (both -1 codes kept), unorm16 and float32; MRT frame preload refuses a raw target explicitly (raw never reaches MRT: mrt_format_ok). Mali disasm (host): TEX_FETCH.u32 + BLEND.u32. Tests: RAW_TARGETS ok=31/31 clear_ok=31 load_ok=31 blend_refused=31; rt_format_oracle adds PRELOAD_SELECT (49 formats: raw -> uint programs + twin, blendable -> float programs). (2) SAMPLER FACTORY: sampler_state.inc #define TEGU_SAMPLER_EXACT_FACTORY 1 default (0 = legacy narrow admission); consumers already carry or refuse exact state (render: tegu_generic_v2_required forces the v2 sidecar for any non-legacy-word sampler; compute: TeguAIRComputeResource fields; fixed paths: tegu_sampler_legacy_ok). Host test SAMPLER_FACTORY exact=42 legacy_refused=42 both_refused=32 legacy_kept=4 exact_draw=1 (mip 1/2, all 6 address modes, compare 1..7, aniso 2..16, LOD clamps, pixel coords admitted+recorded; repeat+linear-mip+4x aniso sampler on a mipmapped texture draws status 4 via v2). STILL REFUSED by both states: lodAverage=YES, supportArgumentBuffers=YES, reductionMode min/max (note: translator measures Metal reading these as weighted average on devices answering supportsSamplerReductionMode=NO - candidate to map instead of refuse), borderColor >2, filters/mip/address/compare enums outside Metal's, maxAnisotropy 0 or >16, lodMinClamp<0, lodMin>lodMax, non-finite clamps; at bind time integer textures with ClampToZero/border use the integer rules, compare without a compare function refuses. sampler_state_host_test.inc also gets both-state tests (its render_frontend_host_test.m harness is pre-existing non-compiling, so the executed coverage is in texture_format_frontend_test). (3) BUG FIX pipeline_cache_frontend.inc: the variant re-store table could match a released pipeline's reused handle address and re-store under the wrong key (SRGB carried=0 in an isolated run); key_note now drops older records of the same address.
